name: Chain Combination (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Tae Kwon Do, Dex 13, Acrobatics 1 rank or BAB +1

Benefit(s): When using this style, you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls for every previous successful unarmed attack against any opponent (Maximum bonus equal to your character level, minimum +1). This bonus resets to +0 if you miss an attack or combat ends.
